name: Network Science, PhD (Boston)
disclaimer: NU Map is an independent, student-built planner. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or officially connected to Northeastern University. Data is scraped from Northeastern's public catalog and refreshed on a schedule; always confirm with the official catalog and an academic advisor.

legend.notes: Sentences quoted verbatim from the catalog page that state a condition we could NOT express as structure — exclusions ("Research courses may not be used"), eligibility lists, per-course grade minimums. A section can consist of nothing but these. Quote them; never infer from them that a particular course does or does not satisfy the section.
legend.creditsRequired: Semester hours the catalog states for a section whose courses it does not list. Do not add these into a program total: some restate credit that another section already counts.

requirementSections.title: Core Requirements
notes: Students must complete all 20 semester hours of the core courses listed below, unless the program director approves changes to the student's course plan:

requirementSections.title: Electives
notes: Complete 20 semester hours from the following elective course options.

The student's elective course plan should be discussed with, and approved by, their advisor. Students who seek to apply courses not on this list to fulfill program requirements must obtain written approval from their advisor and the program director. Elective options below are organized by domain areas. Students may take courses from one or more domain areas.

requirementSections.title: Precandidacy
notes: Students should register for NETS 8986 after passing the qualifying exam and before completing the comprehensive exam (proposal defense):

requirementSections.title: Dissertation
notes: After passing the comprehensive exam (reaching candidacy), students should register for NETS 9990 and NETS 9991, successively:

requirementSections.title: Dissertation Continuation
notes: After completing both NETS 9990 and NETS 9991, students should register for NETS 9996 each semester until graduation:
